profile.Name: Jeremiah the Entrenched
profile.Personality: Pompous and nervous. He loathes the aristocrats of the United Cities and wants their wealth shared, yet he lives like a lord, orders his guards to fetch him wine and food, and calls visitors his subjects. He plays pranks, hides from people who unsettle him, and leaves the dirty work to others.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Dune Renegades from Shraff, among the dunes, where his guards call him Lord Jeremiah. He vows that the rebels will bring down the Empire and means to take hold of the Great Desert when the time comes. A rebel tract on the Empire's corruption was written down for him before he vanished into the dunes.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Imperious and petulant: 'Make it quick, drifter, I'm busy.' He swears by the sands and the Eagle of the Sands, mangles names such as Nagata, and breaks into a wheezing 'KWEHHHHEHEHEHEHEH!' at his own jokes.
